pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on multi-ticket entry clustering within a 60-second window; subsequent scale-in orders are blocked unless the initial entry has traveled at least +$10 in profit and moved to break-even.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a 3-bar structural volume and ATR expansion breakout confirmation over the 15-minute moving average before placing any order, completely banning raw touching-limit stop entries.
profit_harvest_threshold: Dynamic trailing stop initialization at +$5.00 profit, locking in minimum +$3.00, while scaling out partial volume to guarantee target asymmetric expansion toward +$15.00 to +$30.00.
